name: web-sky-and-cloud-fintech-landing-page
title: Fintech landing page on a cloud-and-sky backdrop with a hand holding the app
whatItIs: A long page where a photographic cloud sky runs through every section: a hero with 'Smarter Banking Everyday', a hand holding a phone with floating widgets; a statement paragraph over a blue orb; a transfer card with blue gradient; feature cards; pricing with the popular plan tinted; testimonials; CTA and another phone in hand. Text is light navy.
whatItMeans: Airy, trustworthy and optimistic; clouds evoke lightness and freedom from financial weight.
techniques: Use one continuous sky photograph as the page background.
Float small stat cards around a hand-held phone.
Write light-weight navy headlines with one darker phrase.
Tint the featured pricing card in the sky blue.
Fade white panels over the clouds between sections.
bestFor: Fintech and wellness brands wanting an airy tone

vocabulary.definition: A cloud photo used as a page background.
A small UI card hovering around a device.
A blurred blue sphere used as an accent.
A white panel whose edge fades into the background.
